items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: I know Bill Cray used to tell me he went over there and played with Mike Trepanie.

ctx.x: No place on the West side. There's another side. It's here, but I'm not sure there's something there yet. It's a good while back there was the Wabbit before.

Yeah, but I think they don't play there. No, I think they don't play there. That's where we're at first. I tried to play with Johnny. McDonald? Yeah, Johnny McDonald. I know Bill Cray used to tell me he went over there and played with Mike Trepanie. Yeah. He was in the city the other night. Mike?

Yeah, he and Joe Steve. They're not doing it. I don't know just why they can't get anything steady. No. Well, Mike's something like it's in the city. Yeah. They know how to handle it or put the people in the city. It's a one-sided deal or what? Well, I haven't heard Mike play too much, but I heard him a few times.
